newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise sees no Tractebel problems.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise sees no Tractebel problems.

text.p: Lyonnaise des Eaux chairman Jerome Monod said he believed there were no Belgian political problems concerning a possible merger with Cie de Suez and he added he did not aim to absorb Tractebel. "After the recent talks that (Suez chairman Gerard) Mestrallet has had with Belgian officials, I do not believe that there are Belgian political problems," he told a news conference.
Monod added that Tractebel, Belgium's biggest utility company, was a well run company and Lyonnaise had no wish to substitute for the Tractebel management.
He said that in a new group, Lyonnaise and Tractebel would cooperate closely on international markets but maintain their respective home markets.
